failure_summary.description: Agents chose an associated person, place, object, or page label instead of resolving the clue’s actual target and satisfying its full details.
Answers contained the right identity but added a generic or unnecessary word, such as a company suffix, entity type, or descriptive modifier.

patch.reasoning: The skill already instructs agents to identify the requested answer slot, resolve grammatical relations and implicit references, match the full clue rather than a keyword, and give only the minimal identifying form. These failures reflect not following those existing rules, so repeating them would add no clear gap coverage.
